candidates.review_note: Mask/remainder DP appends each digit once. Identical digits are consumed in sorted occurrence order, eliminating duplicate permutations while retaining leading zeros.

Remove common gcd factors while checking impossible divisibility and early exponents, then solve the coprime residual with baby-step/giant-step. Smallest baby indices and increasing giant blocks preserve the minimum nonnegative exponent.
Reduced proper fractions with denominator b are counted by Euler phi(b). A totient sieve and prefix sum answer all requested bounds, excluding both zero and one.
A min-heap orders next trigger time then query ID. After each returned query, schedule its next occurrence by adding its own period.
Prefix maxima of previous-occurrence indices identify the leftmost permissible start for every distinct suffix; a range is distinct exactly when its left endpoint is beyond that maximum.
For length at least ten, partition lengths 1,2,3,n-6 are pairwise distinct and therefore the pieces differ. Exhaustively inspect all three cuts for shorter strings.
Each character doubles the distinct subsequences, except subsequences already generated by its previous occurrence. Retain the previous prefix total per character and include the empty subsequence.
Every nonroot ID appears exactly once among all child sums. Subtracting those sums from all node IDs leaves the unique root ID even if several tree structures fit the observations.

Search the rightmost digit that can be decreased while completing every digit count to even. Fill required odd-parity digits plus as many pairs of nines as possible in descending order; if the length cannot be preserved, use all nines two digits shorter.
Compress adjacent equal colors. Interval DP either paints the first color separately or shares its stroke with a later equal color while independently repainting the intervening interval.

The squared-distance quadratic over the parameter square reaches its minimum on an edge or at its unconstrained stationary point. Check four point-to-segment boundaries and the feasible interior solution using exact rational arithmetic, including degenerate segments.
Repeated shuffling eventually leaves cows exactly on functional-graph cycles. Iteratively remove zero-indegree vertices; every remaining vertex belongs to a cycle and stays occupied forever.
